title: Get a brand-new Apple Pencil Pro for a record-low $85 in this open-box Woot deal
content:
Macworld

Apple Pencil Pro

View Deal

If you’ve had an iPad for a while, at some point you’re going to want to use it to its full potential. That’s where the Apple Pencil Pro comes in, but you probably don’t want to spend another $129 just for an accessory. Today you don’t have to: The Apple Pencil Pro is down to $85 at Woot right now, a savings of $54, and the lowest we’ve seen it for at Amazon is $99.

So what’s the catch? Well, this Woot deal is for Apple Pencil Pros that are new, but come in an open box. We know everyone loves opening Apple boxes, but for this price, we’re OK with it.

The Pencil Pro feels like a real pen or brush, depending on what you’re using it for. Along with the comfortable design, it responds to tilt and pressure, so pressing harder gives you a darker, thicker line. Tilting it to the side helps you shade the way a pencil would. Whether you’re sketching things or writing handwritten notes, this pencil will do it all. Even better, the Pencil Pro comes with gestures. If you squeeze the barrel, you can pull up the tool palette. If you twist the Pencil in your fingers, you rotate a brush or pen tip. That will make calligraphy work look insanely good.

This particular Apple Pencil Pro is compatible with the M4 and M5 iPad Pro, M2, M3, and M4 iPad Air 11-inch, and iPad mini (A17 Pro and A20 Pro). To charge it, you just snap it to the edge of your tablet magnetically and forget about it. It’s a true must-have accessory, so snatch this Apple Pencil Pro for $85 at Woot before the deal runs out.
